purpose: Define how real external conversations may later teach product capability without turning raw user text into canonical memory.
hardRules: Live-human metrics are reported separately from synthetic metrics.
Raw public conversation text does not become canonical OS memory automatically.
A user message never becomes financial, methodological or identity truth merely because it was submitted to Ask.
Secrets, signing/transaction requests, credentials, private keys, seed phrases and sensitive personal data are excluded from learning examples.
No automatic code patch, methodology mutation, Proposal approval or execution authority is created from live-human traffic.

metricIsolation.syntheticMutation: measures generalization to unseen surface forms
metricIsolation.ownerUnknown: discovers missing synthesis capability without a pre-known answer
metricIsolation.liveHuman: discovers what real people actually need and how they naturally ask

durableCompression: raw conversations -> aggregate evidence -> failure class -> reviewed hypothesis -> accepted/rejected lesson -> regression result
durableHypothesisRule: Preserve both accepted and rejected reviewed hypotheses with origin and evidence reference so future models or maintainers do not repeatedly rediscover rejected approaches.
